## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 2/11 sectors positive. VXX complacent: VXX (1W: -0.64% | 1M: -12.00%) BELOW TREND and Stocks vs Bonds neutral: SPY/TLT (SPY (1W: -0.54% | 1M: +0.54%) CORRECTION) show mixed risk signals while Credit Spread is rising (Level 0.7518, 1W: +0.59% | 1M: +1.02%) ABOVE TREND — two independent confirmations for neutral.

2. Primary Risk Drivers?
Credit stress rising: HYG (1W: -0.48% | 1M: +0.28%) CORRECTION and LQD (1W: -1.12% | 1M: -0.42%) BELOW TREND alongside widening credit spread (↑ rising). Commodity/reflation impulse intact: XLE (1W: +4.37% | 1M: +10.17%) ABOVE TREND and BNO (1W: +10.55% | 1M: +16.16%) ABOVE TREND are driving sector skew.

3. Financial Conditions Signal?
Neutral-to-tighter: Dollar strength stable UUP proxy (Dollar Level 28.21, 1W: +0.68% | 1M: +0.18%) ABOVE TREND while long-duration bonds are pressured: TLT (1W: -1.54% | 1M: -0.01%) BELOW TREND and the yield curve is ↓ falling (below trend).

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?
Energy and Tech are the only leaders: XLE (1W: +4.37% | 1M: +10.17%) ABOVE TREND and XLK (1W: +1.05% | 1M: +3.15%) ABOVE TREND. Broad weakness elsewhere — Financials XLF (1W: -2.36% | 1M: -1.29%) and Consumer Discretionary XLY (1W: -3.66% | 1M: -4.87%) BELOW TREND — style mixed / no clear leadership.

5. US vs Global?
US flat-to-slightly weaker on the week: SPY (1W: -0.54% | 1M: +0.54%) CORRECTION. EM/China mixed: EEM (1W: -0.71% | 1M: +3.81%) CORRECTION while FXI (1W: -0.62% | 1M: -3.07%) BELOW TREND.

6. Speculative Appetite?
Speculation cooling but still elevated over 1M: IBIT (1W: -2.15% | 1M: +21.02%) CORRECTION and ARKK (1W: -3.81% | 1M: +12.97%) CORRECTION show 1W weakness vs 1M strength. Small caps are weak: IWM (1W: -2.89% | 1M: -1.91%) BELOW TREND.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?
Reflation broadening: UGA (1W: +9.70% | 1M: +17.88%) ABOVE TREND, WEAT (1W: +9.25% | 1M: +15.42%) ABOVE TREND and CORN (1W: +3.57% | 1M: +13.16%) ABOVE TREND. Precious metals profit-taking: GLD (1W: -7.32% | 1M: +6.74%) CORRECTION.

8. Energy Trend?
Energy confirmed: XLE (1W: +4.37% | 1M: +10.17%) ABOVE TREND, BNO (1W: +10.55% | 1M: +16.16%) ABOVE TREND and USO (1W: +11.77% | 1M: +15.46%) ABOVE TREND; nat gas also strong: UNG (1W: +3.42% | 1M: +4.65%) ABOVE TREND.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?
CONFIRMED: Energy leadership is consistent across XLE/BNO/USO (all ABOVE TREND). DIVERGENCE: multiple thematic/precious-metal/crypto ETFs (GLD, SLV, ARKK, IBIT) are in CORRECTION with 1W weakness vs 1M strength — a minor divergence set against very narrow sector breadth.

10. Portfolio Direction?
Favor exposure to energy reflation and selective technology: XLE (1W: +4.37% | 1M: +10.17%) ABOVE TREND and XLK (1W: +1.05% | 1M: +3.15%) ABOVE TREND are showing strength; reduce exposure to small caps and rate-sensitive credit: IWM (1W: -2.89% | 1M: -1.91%) BELOW TREND and LQD (1W: -1.12% | 1M: -0.42%) BELOW TREND.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?
BULLISH: Energy XLE (1W: +4.37% | 1M: +10.17%) ABOVE TREND — watch continuation on oil-led flows. BEARISH: Consumer Discretionary XLY (1W: -3.66% | 1M: -4.87%) BELOW TREND and Industrials XLI (1W: -3.18% | 1M: -5.69%) BELOW TREND — watch for further downside.

12. Commodities to Watch?
BULLISH: Oil/BNO (1W: +10.55% | 1M: +16.16%) ABOVE TREND and agricultural baskets UGA/WEAT/CORN ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: Gold GLD (1W: -7.32% | 1M: +6.74%) CORRECTION — monitor whether this is a sustained correction or capitulation.

13. Key Levels?
VXX ~18.6 (complacency threshold), Credit Spread ~0.75 (stress barometer), HYG/LQD ~0.80 (credit health pivot), XLK/XLF ratio ~3.21 (tech vs financials leadership pivot).

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 2/11 sectors positive. Energy and Technology are showing relative strength (XLE (1W: +4.37% | 1M: +10.17%) ABOVE TREND; XLK (1W: +1.05% | 1M: +3.15%) ABOVE TREND). Key risk is rising credit stress and 1W weakness across precious metals/crypto/thematic ETFs (GLD, ARKK, IBIT in CORRECTION) amid very narrow market breadth.
